connector.name: Taisly Social Media Posting
connector.registryDescription: Publish videos to TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X, and Facebook through Taisly.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.taisly.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the taisly account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TAISLY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Run `taisly setup --agent <agent-slug>` to store a local Taisly agent credential, or set this manual API key from Taisly Settings.
